arxiv-2101-12710.title: Information Causality without concatenation
arxiv-2101-12710.creator: Nikolai Miklin, Marcin Pawłowski
arxiv-2101-12710.description: Abstract Information Causality is a physical principle which states that the amount of randomly accessible data over a classical communication channel cannot exceed its capacity, even if the sender and the receiver have access to a source of nonlocal correlations.

arxiv-2203-06897.title: Drift Reduced Navigation with Deep Explainable Features
arxiv-2203-06897.creator: Mohd Omama 1 , Sundar Sripada V. S. 1 , Sandeep Chinchali 2 , Arun Kumar Singh 3 , K. Madhava Krishna 1
arxiv-2203-06897.description: Abstract Modern autonomous vehicles (AVs) often rely on vision, LIDAR, and even radar-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) frameworks for precise localization and navigation. However, modern SLAM frameworks often lead to unacceptably high levels of drift (i.e., localization error) when AVs observe few visually distinct features or encounter occlusions due to dynamic obstacles.

arxiv-2208-09132.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics with the Coupled Discrete Unified Gas Kinetic Scheme (CDUGKS) 2015 Computational Fluid Dynamics with the Coupled Discrete Unified Gas Kinetic Scheme (CDUGKS) – References
arxiv-2208-09132.creator: Alvaro Zamora, Elliott Slaughter, Tom Abel
arxiv-2208-09132.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alvaro Zamora, Elliott Slaughter, Tom Abel. In this paper, we introduce our open source implementation of the Coupled Discrete Unified Gas Kinetic Scheme (CDUGKS), a phase space scheme capable of handling a wide range of flow regimes. We demonstrate its performance on several well known test problems from the astrophysical fluid dynamics literature such as the 1D Sod shock tube and Einfeldt rarefaction, 2D Kelvin-Helmholtz instability, 1D thermoacoustic wave, a triangular Gresho vortex, a sine wave velocity perturbation.

arxiv-2210-06448.title: Debiased inference for a covariate-adjusted regression function
arxiv-2210-06448.creator: Kenta Takatsu, Ted Westling
arxiv-2210-06448.description: Abstract In this article, we study nonparametric inference for a covariate-adjusted regression function. This parameter captures the average association between a continuous exposure and an outcome after adjusting for other covariates. Under certain causal conditions, it also corresponds to the average outcome had all units been assigned to a specific exposure level, known as the causal dose-response curve.

arxiv-2303-14451.title: Near Equilibrium Constraints on Bulk Viscous Models in f ⁡ ( R , T ) = R + 2 ​ λ ​ T f(R,T)=R+2\lambda T Gravity
arxiv-2303-14451.creator: Vishnu A Pai, Titus K Mathew
arxiv-2303-14451.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vishnu A Pai, Titus K Mathew. Recent studies indicate that, near equilibrium condition could not be maintained for bulk viscous matter models during the accelerated expansion of the universe in the context of Einstein’s gravity, without including the cosmological constant. But from our investigation in f ⁡ ( R , T ) f(R,T) gravity, it is observed that, this condition can be satisfied in this modified gravity regime by properly constraining the coupling and viscous parameters.

arxiv-2306-02945.title: Searching for signatures of H α \alpha spicule-like features in the solar transition region
arxiv-2306-02945.creator: Nived Vilangot Nhalil, Juie Shetye, J. Gerry Doyle
arxiv-2306-02945.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nived Vilangot Nhalil, Juie Shetye, J. Gerry Doyle. New instrumental and telescopes covering the optical and ultra-violet spectral regions have revealed a range of small-scale dynamic features, many which may be related. For example, the range of spicule-like features hints towards a spectrum of features and not just two types; however, direct observational evidence in terms of tracking spicules across multiple wavelengths are needed in order to provide further insight into the dynamics of the Sun’s outer atmosphere.

arxiv-2405-04028.title: Masked Graph Transformer for Large-Scale Recommendation
arxiv-2405-04028.creator: Huiyuan Chen, Zhe Xu, Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Vivian Lai, Yan Zheng Minghua Xu, Hanghang Tong
arxiv-2405-04028.description: Abstract . Graph Transformers have garnered significant attention for learning graph-structured data, thanks to their superb ability to capture long-range dependencies among nodes. However, the quadratic space and time complexity hinders the scalability of Graph Transformers, particularly for large-scale recommendation.

arxiv-2512-05109.title: Global phase diagram of two-dimensional dirty hyperbolic Dirac liquids
arxiv-2512-05109.creator: Christopher A. Leong, Daniel J. Salib, Bitan Roy
arxiv-2512-05109.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christopher A. Leong, Daniel J. Salib, Bitan Roy. Within the framework of the canonical nearest-neighbor tight-binding model for spinless fermions, a family of two-dimensional bipartite hyperbolic lattices hosts massless Diraclike excitations near half-filling with the iconic vanishing density of states (DOS) near zero energy.

arxiv-2512-12963.title: SCAdapter: Content-Style Disentanglement for Diffusion Style Transfer
arxiv-2512-12963.creator: Luan Thanh Trinh, Kenji Doi, Atsuki Osanai
arxiv-2512-12963.description: Abstract Diffusion models have emerged as the leading approach for style transfer, yet they struggle with photo-realistic transfers, often producing painting-like results or missing detailed stylistic elements. Current methods inadequately address unwanted influence from original content styles and style reference content features.

arxiv-2512-15849.title: Cosmological Neutron Stars Produce Diffuse Axion X-Ray Signatures
arxiv-2512-15849.creator: Orion Ning, Kailash Raman, Benjamin R. Safdi
arxiv-2512-15849.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Orion Ning, Kailash Raman, Benjamin R. Safdi. Axion-like particles can be abundantly produced through scattering processes in the cores of neutron stars (NSs). If they are ultralight ( m a ≲ 10 − 4 m_{a}\lesssim 10^{-4} eV), then they can efficiently convert to detectable photons in the external NS magnetospheres, and if they are heavy ( m a ≳ 1 m_{a}\gtrsim 1 eV), then they can decay into photons before reaching Earth.

arxiv-2601-12146.title: From LLMs to Agents in Programming: The Impact of Providing an LLM with a Compiler
arxiv-2601-12146.creator: Viktor Kjellberg, Miroslaw Staron, Farnaz Fotrousi
arxiv-2601-12146.description: Abstract Large Language Models have demonstrated a remarkable capability in natural language and program generation and software development. However, the source code generated by the LLMs does not always meet quality requirements and may fail to compile. Therefore, many studies evolve into agents that can reason about the problem before generating the source code for the solution.

pmc-12613560.title: “What does the word loneliness mean to you?” Reflections on co-developing public engagement workshops to facilitate discussions of loneliness with older adults from ethnically diverse groups
pmc-12613560.creator: Jessica Rees, Madiha Sajid, Circle Steele, Marie Croker, Wei Liu, Faith Matcham
pmc-12613560.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundLoneliness is a growing public health concern with known health and wellbeing consequences. The issue is often overlooked in ethnically diverse groups despite language and cultural barriers increasing the risk of social isolation. It is important to deepen our understanding of loneliness in later life from a multi-cultural perspective to design loneliness interventions that are appropriate within and across ethnic groups.

pmc-13070432.title: Serum Magnesium and Bone Health in Pediatric Nephrotic Syndrome: A Cross-Sectional Study From South Asia
pmc-13070432.creator: Shaifalika Thakur, Sanat K Thakur, Tanwi Singh, Sunil Kishore
pmc-13070432.description: BackgroundMetabolic bone disease (MBD) is common in pediatric nephrotic syndrome (NS), yet magnesium (Mg)-a co-factor for vitamin D metabolism and parathyroid hormone (PTH) secretion-has been under-studied.ObjectiveTo evaluate serum Mg status in children with NS and its relationship with bone health and mineral metabolism.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study of consecutively enrolled children with NS (N=370) at a tertiary center.

pmc-13412678.title: Medical Management of Modifiable Risks: Improving Survival in High-Risk Prostate Cancer Patients Receiving Brachytherapy
pmc-13412678.creator: Shalini Moningi, Grgur Mirić, Robert W. Galbreath, Ryan Fiano, Kent E. Wallner, Mutlay Sayan, Peter F. Orio, Martin King
pmc-13412678.description: Background: High-risk (HR) prostate cancer has a propensity for local and distant progression with ultimate death, mandating aggressive locoregional and systemic treatment approaches to maximize oncologic outcomes. Although brachytherapy (BT) with supplemental therapies has demonstrated favorable biochemical and quality of life outcomes, improvements in overall survival have been hampered by an excessive incidence of non- prostate cancer deaths.

pmc-13449322.title: Disrupted anastomotic pseudoaneurysm in arteriovenous grafts: an etiology-driven case series with a proposed preliminary management framework
pmc-13449322.creator: Aiqiang Zhou, Liangzhu Hu, Yafei Zi, Yong Lu, Chao Wang, Yedong He, Haihong Zhang, Wei Deng, Bailin Yu, Tao Huang, Luxiang Wen, Yangdong Liu
pmc-13449322.description: BackgroundDisruption of an anastomotic pseudoaneurysm in an arteriovenous graft (AVG) is a rare but life-threatening complication in hemodialysis patients, distinct from the more common graft-body pseudoaneurysms caused by repeated needle puncture. A systematic management framework for this specific entity is currently lacking.

pmc-13561477.title: Contraceptive practices among spouses of individuals with schizophrenia: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13561477.creator: Jag Mohan Prajapati, Dheerendra K. Mishra, Daisy Rure
pmc-13561477.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:The reproductive and sexual health needs of spouses of individuals with schizophrenia often go unaddressed in psychiatric care.
